reasons: The cited Section 12.1 sets a single fixed Term running until expiry of Sanofi's payment obligations, with no automatic renewal, no successive renewal term, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift — so there is nothing that could fail the RENEWAL fallback.

Absence of an auto-renewal mechanic means any extension requires mutual written agreement, which is the playbook's preferred position; treating the rule as effectively satisfied/not applicable and raising no redline is the correct handling for a customer-side review.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is what a compliant finding should look like; the finding is retained only as internal evidence.
The failed deterministic check ('notice window number not found') is consistent with, rather than contrary to, the conclusion — there is no notice window to measure.
Minor: the rationale cites Section 12.2(a)(i) termination-for-convenience text that is not among the supplied paragraphs, but this is supporting colour only and does not affect the classification.
